description: Deterministically reduce text, JSON, file sets or environment selections. Sequential baseline, candidate and final trials stop when the failure threshold is decided. Accept only reproducing reductions; preserve originals and candidate evidence.

args.description: Literal executable arguments, including an empty array, opt out of shell parsing. Minimize replaces only entire {input} arguments with each candidate path. Windows .cmd/.bat shims require shell mode.

command.description: Shell command when args is absent; executable when args is present. Command and arguments together are limited to 64 KiB. Executed with your local permissions.

cwd.description: Working directory; relative paths resolve from the server working directory.

env.description: Explicit environment overrides. null unsets an inherited variable.

executionRequirement.description: Optional checkpoint emitted after the intended check ran. Missing evidence makes classification/verification inconclusive; Verify inherits it from the baseline.

maxCandidateBytes.description: Cumulative retained input copy byte cap; default 256 MiB. Exhaustion preserves best available input without claiming final verification.

maxInputBytes.description: Input file or directory byte cap; default 16 MiB.

maxOutputBytes.description: Combined stdout/stderr byte cap per trial; default 16 MiB. Limit outcomes are inconclusive.

maxTotalOutputBytes.description: Combined output byte cap for this whole experiment, including all candidates; default 256 MiB.

oneOf.description: One exact NUnit 3 test fullname. Pass an entire {testReport} argument to the test runner result-file option, or write to FAILTRACE_TEST_REPORT. Missing/skipped tests, malformed reports and unrelated failures are inconclusive. Optional messageContains follows a specific failure inside that test.

repeat.description: Maximum trials per candidate; default 1. For intermittent failures, preselect a larger budget (for example 5 with minFailures 1). One trial can reject a useful reduction by chance; extra trials cost time and do not establish confidence.

name: failtrace_minimize
title: Minimize a reproducing input
